message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime. Facts: Zhao purchased two tax authority-issued invoices (代开统一发票) from a small ad place, fake invoices, and provided them to a contractor to receive payment. This is falsifying tax invoices, i.e., "虚开发票". Under Chinese criminal law, the offense is "虚开发票罪" (crime of issuing false invoices). The instruction: When listing the crime name(s) between the [罪名] and <eoa> tags, output only the statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "虚开发票". Also need to consider if multiple offenses? Only one distinct illegal tax-related action: falsifying invoices. So single offense.

Thus final answer: [罪名]虚开发票<eoa>
